name: cartesian-chart
title: Cartesian chart
description: The shared frame behind the area, line and bar charts: scales, axes, the hover readout, the legend and an accessible data table.

name: area-chart
title: Area chart
description: One or more series drawn as a crisp line over a dithered fill that is densest under the line.

name: bar-chart
title: Bar chart
description: Vertical bars, grouped or stacked, each filled with a dither and capped with a solid edge.

name: line-chart
title: Line chart
description: Lines for one or more series, with optional dithered range bands and point markers.

name: sparkline
title: Sparkline
description: A tiny inline trend for tables and stat cards: a line, a dithered area and a dot on the latest value.

name: heatmap
title: Heatmap
description: A calendar or matrix heatmap built from dither cells: each square steps from a few dots to solid, with a readout and a level scale.
